summary: Keeping a DDDD 4/4 count is an act of mediation. 6 bars in and suddenly I am fooling around with mutes and strum patterns. Its focus I need to learn not chords.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Keeping a DDDD 4/4 count is an act of mediation. 6 bars in and suddenly I am fooling around with mutes and strum patterns.

Its focus I need to learn not chords.
